narrative.filled_text: An unbeaten champion is a rare thing, and Unavailable earned every word of it. Unavailable's side closed out a 8-0-0 campaign with u03 finishing as the tournament's defining forward.
Knockout football is unforgiving, and Unavailable learned it in the round of 16. T08 advanced; the dream paused for another four years.
Unavailable's side cleared the group and stumbled at the next step. The round of 16 was as far as Unavailable went, on a 2-1-2 run with plenty to build on.
They came, they conquered, they never blinked. A spotless 8-0-0 carried Unavailable to glory, with u04 terrorising defences from the first whistle of the group stage to the last of the final.
A tournament to forget. Unavailable left the group stage winless, a red-card swing about the only thing worth replaying from a difficult three games.
